description: Implementation of CTR_DRBG (Counter mode Deterministic Random Byte Generator) based on SP 800-90Ar1, including functions for creation, initialization, reseeding, generation, and cleanup of the DRBG state.

methods.name: CTR_DRBG_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new CTR_DRBG_STATE with provided entropy and optional personalization.

methods.name: CTR_DRBG_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for CTR_DRBG_STATE.

methods.name: CTR_DRBG_init
methods.description: Initializes the CTR_DRBG_STATE with entropy and personalization data.

methods.name: CTR_DRBG_reseed
methods.description: Reseeds the DRBG with new entropy and optional additional data.

methods.name: CTR_DRBG_generate
methods.description: Generates pseudorandom bytes, optionally incorporating additional data.
